editions.title: This weekend in motorsport
editions.intro: A busy week of racing awaits from 23–28 September, featuring Formula 1, Formula 2, NASCAR Cup Series, NHRA Drag Racing and the World Endurance Championship.

editions.title: Last week in motorsport
editions.intro: The week of 15–21 September saw action across several championships, including the Clio Cup Series, NASCAR Cup Series, IMSA SportsCar Championship, MotoGP and NHRA Drag Racing.

items.headline: Battle on the Bricks

items.headline: Grand Prix of Austria
items.detail: Red Bull Ring - Spielberg, Austria · Sun 20 Sep
items.body: Pedro Acosta from Red Bull KTM Factory Racing won the Grand Prix of Austria, followed by Jorge Martin and Marco Bezzecchi, both with Aprilia Racing.
